properties.mass_source: Component wires: M22759/16 slash-sheet max weight, lbs/1000 ft (Glenair, https://cdn.glenair.com/wire-and-cable/pdf/b/m22759-16.pdf). Shield and jacket mass are a geometric estimate from the same core-packing / braid-wall / jacket-wall model used for OD; MIL-DTL-27500 does not tabulate finished cable weight.

build_notes: Wire identification per MIL-DTL-27500 Table IIIA using the stripe method
Shield is round, silver-coated copper at 85% minimum coverage
Overall diameter 0.253 in is estimated from the component wire diameter; MIL-DTL-27500 does not tabulate finished cable OD
Finished cable mass includes slash-sheet component-wire weight plus an estimated shield/jacket; MIL-DTL-27500 does not tabulate finished cable weight
